title: Shen-yan-yi-hao oral solution ameliorates IgA nephropathy via intestinal IL-17/NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Song, Huan; Liang, Guo-Qiang; Yu, Man-Shu; Shan, Yun; Shi, Jun; Jiang, Chun-Bo; Ni, Dao-Lei; Sheng, Mei-Xiao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药口服液对IgA肾病大鼠的疗效及肠道IL-17/NF-kappaB通路机制，虽含分子对接但核心为疾病药理与湿实验验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN) is the most common primary glomerulonephritis in the world, it is one of the most common causes of kidney disease and can lead to end-stage kidney disease, however, its pathogenesis is still complicated. The Shen-yan-yi-hao oral solution (SOLI) is an effective prescription for the clinical treatment of IgAN while its specific mechanism remains to be further elucidated. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study investigates SOLI's effects on IgAN in rats, particularly on the intestinal mucosal barrier, and identifies potential therapeutic targets through network pharmacology and molecular docking, validated experimentally. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Target genes for SOLI in IgAN were identified and analysed through molecular docking and KEGG pathway enrichment. An IgAN rat model examined SOLI's effect on renal biomarkers and cytokines involved in specific pathways, ileum mucosal lesions, and the intestinal immune system. The IL-17 pathway's role was studied in IEC-6 cells with SOLI in vitro. RESULT: Rats developed increased proteinuria and kidney damage marked by IgA deposition and inflammation. SOLI treatment significantly ameliorated these symptoms, reduced galactose-deficient Ig A1 (Gd-IgA1), and decreased cytokines like IL-17, TNF-alpha, IL-6 and IL-1beta etc. SOLI also normalized intestinal tight junction protein expression, ameliorated intestinal damage, and regulated intestinal immune response (focused on IL-17/NF-kappaB signal pathway). SOLI moderated the abnormally activated IL-17 pathway, which damages intestinal epithelial cells, suggesting IgAN treatment potential. CONCLUSION: SOLI reduces proteinuria and enhances intestinal mucosal function in IgAN rats, kidney protection in the IgAN rat model may initiate from modulating the intestinal IL-17/NF-kappaB pathway and subsequent Gd-IgA1 accumulation.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：免疫球蛋白A肾病（IgAN）是全球最常见的原发性肾小球肾炎，是肾脏疾病最常见的病因之一，可导致终末期肾病，然而其发病机制仍较为复杂。肾炎一号口服液（SOLI）是临床治疗IgAN的有效方剂，但其具体机制仍有待进一步阐明。研究目的：本研究探讨SOLI对大鼠IgAN的影响，特别是对肠道黏膜屏障的作用，并通过网络药理学和分子对接识别潜在治疗靶点，并经实验验证。材料与方法：通过分子对接和KEGG通路富集分析，识别并分析SOLI在IgAN中的靶基因。建立IgAN大鼠模型，观察SOLI对肾脏生物标志物、涉及特定通路的细胞因子、回肠黏膜病变及肠道免疫系统的影响。在体外，使用IEC-6细胞研究IL-17通路在SOLI作用下的角色。结果：大鼠出现蛋白尿增加和肾脏损伤，表现为IgA沉积和炎症。SOLI治疗显著改善这些症状，降低半乳糖缺陷型IgA1（Gd-IgA1），并减少IL-17、TNF-α、IL-6和IL-1β等细胞因子。SOLI还恢复肠道紧密连接蛋白表达，改善肠道损伤，并调节肠道免疫反应（聚焦于IL-17/NF-κB信号通路）。SOLI调节异常激活的IL-17通路，该通路损伤肠道上皮细胞，提示其具有IgAN治疗潜力。结论：SOLI减少IgAN大鼠的蛋白尿并增强肠道黏膜功能，其在IgAN大鼠模型中的肾脏保护作用可能始于调节肠道IL-17/NF-κB通路及随后的Gd-IgA1积累。
